attributes.residual: NOTHING TO FIX AT SOURCE, AND FIXING IT WOULD BE A FIDELITY REGRESSION. Our object emits 10 .sbss objects (0x28); the target claim is 0x20. mwld dead-strips three of them - BypassWorkaround, FrameCount, FrameMissThreshold - because the only code that references them (DEMOEnableBypassWorkaround, __BypassRetraceCallback, __BypassDoneRender) is itself unreferenced and stripped. 7 objects survive at 0x1C, which the section's 2**3 alignment rounds to exactly 0x20, and `objdump -t build/GUNE5D/main.elf` places every one at its retail address: DemoHeap 0x80345168, DefaultFifo 0x8034516c, DefaultFifoObj 0x80345170, rmode 0x80345174, DemoCurrentBuffer 0x80345178, DemoFrameBuffer2 0x8034517c, DemoFrameBuffer1 0x80345180. 12 dead bytes minus the 4 bytes of alignment the live set already pays = the 8-byte gap. The three statics and their three functions are genuine DEMO SDK API; deleting them to silence the row would remove correct source and change no image byte. THE SAME MECHANISM IS 48x LARGER IN .text AND `--sections` CANNOT SEE IT: DEMOInit.o's .text is 0xC90 against a 0x64C claim, a 1604-byte surplus, because __DEMOInitRenderMode/__DEMOInitGX/__DEMOInitVI inline into DEMOInit and their out-of-line copies strip, along with DEMOReInit and the three Bypass functions. datadiff --sections iterates DATA_SECTIONS + extab/extabindex + .bss/.sbss/.sbss2 and never reads .text at all.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: A Matching unit whose linked .text extent does NOT equal its splits.txt claim size - i.e. one where the claim range cannot be used as the liveness test. Measured on DEMOInit: LoadMemInfo 0x228 + DEMODoneRender 0x58 + DEMOSwapBuffers 0x38 + __DEMOInitMem 0x108 + DEMOInit 0x28c = 0x64C = exactly the claim 0x800CB600..0x800CBC4C, so the test holds there; it is one objdump per unit to check the other 203.
hypothesis.count_consequence: None - this is a tool-classification change, not a source cure. No instruction count in the image moves; the fix is owned by the tools/gdl lane (claude-fleet-worker-T20 holds tools/gdl this run), which is why this record proposes it rather than applying it.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes - the surplus was screened against the linked main.elf and against config/GUNE5D/splits.txt on all 204 Matching units, and against config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt for DEMOInit's own .sbss range 0x80345168..0x80345188 (7 named symbols, DemoFrameBuffer1 annotated size 0x8 because it is last).
hypothesis.statement: datadiff.py --sections should decide OURS-LARGER by link reachability rather than by section size, and should read .text. The minimal sound form: when the unit is already linked (its Object() state is Matching and main.elf exists), subtract from the surplus every object symbol of that section whose name does not land inside the unit's own splits.txt claim range in main.elf; report the REMAINDER, and keep FLIP BLOCKER only if the remainder is positive. On the current tree that turns 49 rows into 0 without weakening any other class.
